name: Essential Announcement Bar
summary: Shopify announcement bar app for static, rotating and scrolling top, bottom and cart-page bars with links, icons, scheduling, geo-targeting and translations; priced on how many times the bars load each month.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want a free, no-code top bar or rotating bar for shipping terms, offers and store notices, and who will pay $9.99 once they need scheduled flash-sale bars, cart-page bars or country targeting
skip_if: you want the scrolling marquee bar for free, because it starts on the $6.99 plan; your bar will load tens of thousands of times a month and nobody watches the app's email, because at the limit the bars are unpublished and do not come back on their own; or your theme already has an announcement bar that does what you need
honest_knock:
The bar the listing leads with is not on the free plan. The App Store copy opens on scrolling, marquee-style announcement bars, but the vendor's own help article on bar types says running-line announcements require a paid plan, and the pricing table puts them on Starter at $6.99. What the free plan does give you is a static bar and a rotating bar that cycles several messages; one merchant who installed it expecting the moving bar for free left a one-line complaint within half an hour. Scheduling, the feature that lets a flash-sale bar switch itself on and off, and the cart-page bar both start one step higher, on Essential at $9.99.

The view allowance is counted the expensive way. The help centre says a view is every render of a bar: each page load, each reload, and each bar when you run more than one on a page. A top bar sits on every page, so the free plan's 2,000 views is a few hundred browsing sessions a month on a small store, not 2,000 shoppers.

Running out does not cost money, it takes the bar down, and it stays down. Past the limit you get an email; three days later every published bar is unpublished, and the same article says that when views reset on the 1st the bars are not published again automatically. A store that misses the email loses its announcement for the rest of the month and then keeps missing it until someone notices and republishes.

The support that most reviews praise has one account on the other side. In April 2026 a UK merchant with twelve months on the app wrote that the team had published a page on her site without her consent and made styling changes that broke two sales pages shortly before a launch. Essential Apps replied that it was sorry and had only intended to help. If you give support access to fix a placement, say exactly what they may change.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to 20,000 bar views, or $67.08 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-29 on apps.shopify.com/essential-announcement-bar, on essential-apps.com/announcement-bar and in the vendor's help articles on bar types and on views; plan prices, annual prices, view limits and the 7-day trial re-verified unchanged on the Shopify App Store listing on 2026-10-21) Four plans priced on monthly bar views. Free covers up to 2,000 views a month with unlimited simple bars and unlimited rotating bars, each with a link or button. Starter is $6.99 a month, or $67.08 a year at a stated 20% saving, for up to 20,000 views, and adds running-line (scrolling marquee) bars and icons, including your own uploaded icons. Essential is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year for up to 50,000 views, and adds cart-page bars, scheduling, geolocation targeting and translations. Professional is $29.99 a month or $287.88 a year for unlimited views and every premium feature. Paid plans carry a 7-day free trial. A view is counted every time a bar is rendered: per page load, not per visitor, and two bars on one page count twice. There is no overage charge: past the limit you get an email, and if you do not upgrade within 3 days your bars are unpublished; views reset on the 1st of the month, but the help centre says the bars are not published again automatically. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Essential Apps, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 9 August 2023 and shows 1,302 reviews.

compare_with.name: Essential Countdown Timer Bar
compare_with.why: The comparison sits inside one developer. Essential Apps also publishes Essential Countdown Timer Bar, which puts a countdown in a top bar, on product pages, carts and emails. On our reading of 28 September 2026 it used the same price points - $6.99, $9.99 and $29.99 - but gave half the views on the lower plans: 1,000 free and 10,000 on Starter against 2,000 and 20,000 here, with 50,000 on the $9.99 tier in both. Both apps unpublish their widgets three days after you pass the limit. The choice is about the message. A sale with a real end date is what the countdown app is for; shipping terms, store notices and several rotating offers are what this app is for, and it lets you show them twice as often before you pay.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Essential Announcer (listed as Essential Announcement Bar) on a Shopify development store: the install from the app address in the admin, the free plan without a card or plan screen, a simple bar with the text Free shipping over $50. Orders ship in 2 business days. and a Shop now! button that was published in the app, then seen above the store header in an unsaved theme preview only after the app embed was switched on by hand in the theme editor (about 9 minutes and 12 steps; the theme change was undone), the Pricing plans page with the free plan and three paid plans, the Shopify approval screen for Starter (a 7-day trial; it asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence; nothing approved) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. The live store, the view limit and the paid bar types were not tested. Nothing was paid. Install: the test started at 21:21:34 on the app address in the Shopify admin (the apps page of the app), which said You don't have this app installed with an Install button; Install was clicked. In the admin the app is called Essential Announcer, while the listing and the review call it Essential Announcement Bar. The screen said that the app needs access to View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (Products, Online Store, Shopify admin). The app was open at about 21:23 directly on the free plan (You're currently on Free, 0 / 2000 monthly views), without a plan screen, a payment screen or a terms tick box. No account on the vendor site, password, card or phone number was asked. The Home of the app showed a setup guide (Activate app embed in Shopify, Create your first announcement bar, Confirm your announcement is working properly) and a banner Q4 offer: 5 apps for $99/mo; the banner was not clicked. Core action, a simple bar with shipping terms: New announcement, Choose announcement type (Top/Bottom bar, Cart page marked Essential plan, Checkout announcement), Top/Bottom bar chosen. The editor showed a live preview at once, with the types Simple announcement, Running line announcement (marked Starter plan) and Multiple rotating announcements. The title was set to Free shipping over $50. Orders ship in 2 business days. and the preview in the app showed the bar with a button Shop now! at about 21:25. Publish gave Announcement bar created with the status Published and a warning that the app is not activated yet (click Activate and then Save). The bar was not on the store yet: only after the app embed Announcement bar / Essential Announcer was switched on by hand in the theme editor (App embeds) did the bar stand above the store header in the preview, at about 21:30. That preview was not saved and the change was undone with undo, so the bar was not on the live store. The whole way took about 9 minutes and about 12 steps from the start, of which the embed switch in the theme editor was the last part. Plans in the app (Pricing plans, Billed Monthly): Free Plan with Up to 2.000 monthly views, Unlimited simple bars and Unlimited rotating bars; Starter $6.99 a month with up to 20.000 monthly views, Everything in Free, Unlimited running line bars, Add icons to the bar and Upload your own icons; Essential (Popular) $9.99 a month with up to 50.000 monthly views, Unlimited cart page bars, Scheduling, Geolocation targeting and Translations; Professional $29.99 a month with Unlimited views, all premium features and Translations & Geo targeting; each with Start FREE 7-day trial. A switch Billed Yearly - Save 20% was seen; the yearly view was not opened, so the yearly prices were not read. Checkout: Start FREE 7-day trial on Starter (monthly) opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription with the plan starter, $6,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $6,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $6,99 Due 24 Nov, a row Add payment method and the line By proceeding, you are agreeing to the Terms of Service. The Approve button was greyed out. The screen did NOT say that a test charge would not be billed, and a payment method was needed. No card was entered, nothing was approved and no payment method was touched; the screen was left. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so there was nothing to cancel in the app. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app and Uninstall: the dialog says that you can no longer use the app and that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and it asks for a Reason for uninstalling and optional feedback; the reason Testing multiple apps was chosen. Differences from the review: the prices and the limits match the review (Free 2,000 views, Starter $6.99 for 20,000, Essential $9.99 for 50,000, Professional $29.99 unlimited); the only difference is the name of the app in the admin, Essential Announcer. The price fields are not changed here. Not tested: scheduling, country targeting, translations and cart page bars (Essential plan), running line and rotating bars, the countdown timer and free shipping bar that the editor offers with a Create link (a separate tool, not clicked), the view limit and what happens after it, the yearly prices, the paid plans and the payment. Clean up: the theme change was not saved and was undone. The published bar was not deleted by hand and went with the uninstall. The app was uninstalled on 17 November through Settings, Apps and no longer showed under installed apps; other apps were not touched. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The published bar did not show on the store until the app embed was switched on by hand in the theme editor; the app says so in a warning and in its setup guide. The app is called Essential Announcer in the admin and Essential Announcement Bar in the listing. The Home of the app and the editor preview show promotions for other apps of the vendor (a Q4 offer of 5 apps for $99 a month, a block Combine with Essential Loyalty with Install free).
